decision: Appropriate read-only explanatory census if equivalence and scope restrictions hold. No detector fix, new eligible candidate or Length adoption. HOLD.
scope: Frozen protocol and prepare helper reviewed before new census data. Instrumentation/census implementation not present at review and therefore not code-verified here. No browser/image inference, protocol/label/product edit.
strengths: Same frozen V1/V3 C/W Float32 inputs and exposed annotations, with no blind benchmark claim.
Hidden feature/edge instrumentation must preserve original arrays, traces and diagnostics.
All co-occurring gate failures retained; counts are not mutually exclusive or semantic error rates.
Automatic-root BFS route and representative/display ordering fixed before data; manual labels are posthoc destinations, never detector seeds.
NMS contributor audit is diagnostic only, no gap filling or hypothetical acceptance.

implementationCautions.issue: A whole loose-root-connected active component necessarily contains an automatic root that is already strictly visited.
implementationCautions.requirement: Define the phrase loose-connected but strictly-unreached component precisely: components of active AND loose AND NOT strict, or active components containing unreached vertices. Report which subset is used; do not imply a whole loose component lacks all strict vertices.

implementationCautions.issue: Original prototype queue is reused and overwritten by each reverse root census after strict BFS.
implementationCautions.requirement: Capture/reconstruct deterministic root-BFS routes and ordering before reuse. Final queue contents are not original strict-root BFS traversal. Original parent/visited arrays may be stable, but verify rather than infer queue meaning.

implementationCautions.issue: First failing edge on one undirected shortest root route is a route-specific witness, not a unique graph cut or first physical hair break.
implementationCautions.requirement: Keep every co-occurring failed gate and state that another route may fail elsewhere. A first-gate frequency is not causal percentage or evidence changing that gate restores full route/real ownership.

implementationCautions.issue: Raw-directed vs pruned-directed reach attribution requires identical masks, geometry, dimensions and root set.
implementationCautions.requirement: Compare within the same version before interpreting pruning contribution. Across-version NMS/root-mask changes remain separately controlled by prior07 mask proof.

implementationCautions.issue: Posthoc nearest active sample may belong to another shaft or skin texture; ties and native working footprint matter.
implementationCautions.requirement: Use deterministic pixel-index tie handling or record exact ties. Keep engineering uncertainty and source patch visible. Do not interpret association as confirmed same hair or feed its coordinate/direction into detector.

implementationCautions.issue: First removed V1 route pixel can be the initial root itself, not an internal connecting sample.
implementationCautions.requirement: Distinguish root removal from intermediate vertex deletion and include bilinear contributors/active/orientation data. Neither is an invented image gap or proof preserving that pixel safely recovers a lash.

implementationCautions.issue: Exact in-memory source instrumentation is vulnerable to silent anchor mismatch or diagnostic side effects.
implementationCautions.requirement: Assert exact occurrence counts of version-specific anchors, retain original source hash, compare integer masks/parent/structure exactly and float arrays under stated1e-9 only where necessary. Diagnostic routes must not change detector arrays, graph eligibility or returned traces.

interpretationLimits: Observed 8-connectivity can cross fibers/noise; graph root reach is not biological attachment.
Frontier counts depend on sampled grid, seed neighborhood and available reachable graph, not exhaustive image strands.
Instrumentation/object/route storage cost is offline; do not reuse typed-array memory figures as total runtime/process bounds.
No root route or support threshold boundary qualifies as a physical free tip or approved Length.
laterVisualReview: Inspect unchanged original patches with all automatic components/frontiers, fixed representative routes and first removed pixels; retain white-liner/hair/opening negatives and unfavorable V1/V3 results.
